title: Backbends, Blowouts & Brews with Bianchi's + YogaSix Royal Oak
description: Sweetest Day meets self-care! Sculpt + Flow, a blowout, coffee, wine, permanent jewelry & local vendors. $65 | Oct. 17
long_description:
Sweetest Day meets self-care! Sculpt + Flow, a blowout, coffee, wine, permanent jewelry & local vendors. $65 | Oct. 17

About this Event

BACKBENDS, BLOWOUTS & BREWS
Sweetest Day | Saturday, October 17
2:00–5:00 PM | YogaSix Royal Oak + Bianchi’s
$65 per person
Celebrate Sweetest Day with an afternoon dedicated to movement, beauty, shopping, and a little indulgence.

THE EXPERIENCE2:00–3:00 PM | Sculpt + Flow at YogaSix Royal Oak
Kick off the afternoon with a one-hour Sculpt + Flow class designed to get you moving, sweating, strengthening, and feeling amazing. Come ready to work, flow, and have fun!
3:00 PM | Blowout + Brews at Bianchi’s
After class, head next door to Bianchi’s for your blowout experience. While you wait, enjoy a a coffee beverage from Goldie Days and relax with your favorite people.
But we’re not stopping there...
Shop permanent jewelry by The Detroit Bead Co. and discover additional local vendors while you sip, socialize, and get pampered.
And because it’s Sweetest Day, enjoy a complimentary glass of wine on the house, courtesy of Bianchi’s.

YOUR $65 TICKET INCLUDES1-hour Sculpt + Flow class at YogaSix Royal OakBlowout at Bianchi’sCoffee Beverage from Goldie DaysComplimentary winePermanent jewelry shopping with the Detroit Bead Co.Additional local vendorsA full afternoon of movement, beauty, and funGrab your bestie, your sister, your mom, or make it a Sweetest Day date.
$65 | Limited spots available
Come for the backbends. Stay for the blowout.
Sip, shop & celebrate Sweetest Day with us.
